text_block_list.text:
Early morning summer training 
camp, woke up, went outside to see…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ba-ku-shin… 
Ba-ku-shin……!
Sakura Bakushin O jogging.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oya! Trainer-san! 
Good morning!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Yes! Extremely admirable!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
As model class president for Uma 
Musume everywhere, waking early 
given!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Sleep through night, lights out, 
wake with sun! Voluntary training 
before anyone else!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Only by showing everyone who I am 
do I gain high esteem!
Even during training camp, she looks out for others and tries to set a good example. Attitude truly wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: So, Trainer-san, please take lots of pictures of me!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I want to post them in camp hallway as example of a "Model Honors Student"!
Feel this direction is slightly—no, completely mistaken.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Setting that aside! Trainer-san, give me Spartan training, please!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Since long-awaited training camp, thought we should make it exemplary!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: In other words――Spartan training! Intelligent class president like me realized immediately!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: So please, hold nothing back! Train me hard!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: She trained harder than anyone, pushing through mud, sweat, and tears…!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: And so! I will become an even more exemplary class president!
Good she is motivated, at least. Spartan training she might like would be…
choice_data_list: Swimming to her limits in the ocean!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Lifting logs…?
choice_data_list: (Was that as stupid as I thought it was?)
(Was that as stupid as I thought it was?)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: ……Good! Splendid idea, Trainer-san!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Super Spartan!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Bakushin-dash into forest right now!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Mm… Mmmhmhmhm……!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Are there… no logs? All trees standing strong!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Could it be that I…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Aha! If I do not knock tree down first, logs will not exist in this world!
Things would get out of hand if left alone. Just as I went to stop her――

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Ah―――! Excellent idea came to mind!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Trainer-san will be tree!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: And I will lift you!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Here I gooo―!
Scuffled with her for a while after that……

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Push past limits! That is truly Spartan!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Understood, leave it to me! Will show my Bakushin Guts!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Now, past limits! Swim to horizon's end!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Affirmative! Fully stopped!
She would definitely swim straight to sea edge. Dangerous…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Roger!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: ―Wait, not swimming in shallows!
choice_data_list: Class presidents can swim in shallow water!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Now that you say it―! Nothing impossible for me anyway!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: All right, will swim to limits in shallows!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Bakushiiiiin!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Shallows end around here, roughly……

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Ah, you! Crossed right in front of me!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Yes, crab! Nerve challenging me to duel!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Bring it on!
Watched over Sakura Bakushin O frolicking in surf for while……

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Hah, hah……

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Endured to limit…! Fierce crab onslaught!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Spartan training indeed, but conquered it successfully!
Goal shifted midway, but seemed to help her grow regardless?
